STATE NATIONALIST REFORM | Strategic Operations - Technical Manifest

Description:
High-performance SPA focused on asset protection and jurisdictional standing, with a “paramilitary-corporate” aesthetic, interactive data visualization, and embedded intelligence.

Tech Stack:
Vanilla HTML5/JS (modular, ES6+), Tailwind CSS (bundled), Chart.js (interactive bar charts), Plotly.js (interactive Sankey diagrams), Rumble video (lazy-loaded), FormSubmit with client validation, Google Tag Manager with custom tracking.

Design System:
Colors: --pac-red #B91C1C, --pac-navy #0F172A, --pac-bone #F8FAFC
Typography: Headers Oswald, Body Inter
UI Patterns: Sharp edges, high-contrast borders, eased pulse animations, ARIA-compliant

Navigation & Views:
MapsTo(viewId) toggles sections with smooth transitions and keyboard navigation:
Mission (#mission): Hero video + progress indicators
Funding (#funding): Asset Insulation bar chart
Standing (#standing): Sankey diagram with hover tooltips
Vault (#vault): Top Secret document grid

Core JS Logic:
navigation.js: Section visibility, active states, ARIA
charts.js: Chart.js and Plotly initialization with lazy-load
forms.js: FormSubmit POST + validation + honeypot
utils.js: Smooth scroll, debounce, global config

Data Structures:
Public Assets: Vessels of the State / Statutory
Private Assets: 98-Series Protocol / Equitable Title
Supports dynamic updates via JSON endpoints

Inquiry System:
Endpoint: https://formsubmit.co/tom@statenationalistreform.info

POST: Name, Email, Strategic Enquiry
Client validation, honeypot, smooth feedback

Performance & UX:
Lazy-load charts/videos, debounced scroll, ARIA support, mobile-responsive layouts, centralized config

Optional Upgrades:
PWA-ready, event tracking on charts, modular for future expansion
